title: Dark Green 'Coffee All The Way' Starbucks Venti Cold Cup - 2019 Holiday Cups
descriptionText:
No lid, no straw

This dark green Starbucks Venti Cold Cup features the holiday design 'Coffee All The Way' and was created in 2019. The cup is perfect for collectors of Starbucks memorabilia and coffee enthusiasts alike. It is made in China and has not been modified. The cup is labeled as a venti size and is ideal for enjoying cold coffee or tea. The green color scheme adds a touch of festive cheer to your day.
